definitions.explanation: A person who has been physically injured, whether from an accident, disaster, or other incident. Used in news reports, emergency contexts, and everyday conversation about accidents.

examples.japanese: {怪我人|けがにん}はいません⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: Three people were injured in the accident.

examples.japanese: {怪我人|けがにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: The injured person was taken to the hospital by ambulance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧{怪我人|けがにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately there were no injuries, but the damage to the building was extensive.

notes:
Composed of {怪我|けが} (injury) and ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person). The ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ suffix is read にん (not じん) in this compound. The word is standard in news reports and emergency situations to describe anyone who has been physically hurt.

The phrase {怪我人|けがにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (injuries occurred; someone was hurt) is extremely common in news and accident reports. Its opposite — {怪我人|けがにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧ (no one was injured) — is equally standard when reporting the fortunate outcome of an incident.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {怪我人|けがにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: there are injuries / someone is injured
- {怪我人|けがにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧: no one was injured
- {怪我人|けがにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rescue the injured
- {怪我人|けがにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to transport the injured
- ⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{怪我人|けがにん}: a seriously injured person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{負傷者|ふしょうしゃ}→負傷者：27169_fushousha⟧: injured person — a more formal synonym, common in official reports and news
- ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧: victim — broader term including injury, crime, or disaster victims
- ⟦{死傷者|ししょうしゃ}→死傷者：27187_shishousha⟧: casualties (dead and injured) — used when reporting both fatalities and injuries together
